[IRET.16.4] The **`AlphaNode` atom** encodes its `node_id`, the
`schema_name` it filters, and a list of alpha test descriptors (kind,
slot index, op, literal value or compiled-regex pattern string).
Downstream beta inputs reference this node by `node_id`.

idris.name: iret_16_4__alpha_node
idris.note: An alpha node as loaded: its schema and tests, an empty memory.

idris.name: iret_16_4__alpha_nodes
idris.note: The alpha nodes as loaded, in atom order; named so that a statement never mentions the node builder unapplied.

idris.name: iret_16_4__alpha_node_mem
idris.note: A loaded alpha node's memory is empty.

idris.name: iret_16_4__mem_empty
idris.note: Every loaded alpha memory is empty, dangling references included.
